settings.heading: What is Picnic Planning?
settings.intro: Every session, Ryan plans one low floor, high ceiling task with you: easy for every kid to start, with room for the keenest to fly. It's built on the interests of your kids, not generic kids, and it works for littlies, middles and oldies in the same room.
settings.link_label: get the free IN task planner
settings.intro_2: Grab the free planner, press play, and we'll plan this lesson together.

settings.heading: What are Field Notes?
settings.intro: Ryan, out in the field, talking about the small things grown-ups say and do that shape how kids learn. Each one pairs with a field notes post that comes at the idea from another angle.

settings.heading: Questions grown-ups ask us

settings.question: Who are these videos for?
settings.answer: Teachers, parents and homeschoolers of kids 5-13. The Picnic Planning lessons are built for mixed groups, so littlies, middles and oldies can work on the same task at the same time.

settings.question: Are the videos free?
settings.answer: Yes. Every video is free to watch here and on YouTube, and so is the IN task planner Ryan uses in them.

settings.question: What is a rich, open task?
settings.answer: One real question with lots of ways in and no single path to the answer. Every kid starts where they are and goes as far as they can. "How fast can you run 100 metres?" is one.

settings.question: Do I need to print the planner?
settings.answer: No. Ryan fills it in on camera, but a plain sheet of A4 works just as well.

settings.question: Where do the lesson questions come from?
settings.answer: Real kids. Each Picnic Planning lesson starts from a question a kid sent to theINmag, the magazine made by kids, for kids.

settings.question: How do I hear about new videos?
settings.answer: Subscribe on YouTube, get our emails, or check back here. New videos land on this page the day they go live.

settings.heading: Want to go deeper?
settings.copy: Ryan is building short courses on planning rich, open tasks for your own kids. Join free and you'll hear about them first.
